instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。
dose_definition: c(d)=d*clean prompt per-layer median residual L2 excluding first token / down_proj column L2; independent BF16 cast from original double ratio; prompt and all decode steps
sampling: random.Random(f"acupuncture-layer-dose-v1:{model_id}:{layer}").choice(candidates sorted by channel from original ten sampled points); fixed before B outcomes

preflight.cross_worker: all eight baseline token/raw outputs and full 8x32 clean calibration must agree

comparison_scope: Same one-point-per-layer signed dose survey as Qwen; source +1 and baseline reused only from fully completed verified experiment A. Native model differences retained.
authorization_scope: User corrected merged design: two separate experiments exactly as Qwen, and prior direct launch after tests remains authorized. Old product stopped; no reuse of interrupted partial science.
